html:
Given a nonempty integer list, return the largest sum of any nonempty contiguous subarray.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      -3,
      4,
      -1,
      5,
      -8
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 8
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      -5,
      -2,
      -9
    ]
  ],
  "expected": -2
}
Hint

At each value, either extend the previous segment or start a new one.

Complexity: O(n) time; this slice-based version uses O(n) temporary space
